about: Visits to a signup page that changed partway through (July to October 2026). Everyone saw the same page on a given day; there is no comparison group.
review: Goals and labels drafted by Claude on 2026-11-14, paraphrases written by Claude. Labels reviewed by Ben on 2026-11-17 and regraded 2026-11-18: no credit for a near answer on a different measure.

paraphrases: Is the signup rate different since August 30th?
signups before vs after 8/30
Did more visitors register after the end of August?
did sign ups go up after aug 30

labels.why: Signup rate before and after a date.

goals.goal: Did the new signup page work?
paraphrases: Was the signup page redesign a success?
Is the new page better?
did the page refresh do anything
Did our new landing page improve things?

labels.why: A signup page works if more people sign up.

goals.goal: Are people looking at more pages since the redesign?
paraphrases: Did pages per visit go up after the change?
Has page depth increased since the new page?
more pageviews after the redesign?
are visitors browsing more pages now

goals.goal: Since the relaunch, are we converting more visitors?
paraphrases: Has visitor-to-signup conversion improved since we relaunched?
Is our conversion rate up since the new page went live?
conversion since relaunch
are more visiters turning into signups now

labels.why: Conversion here is the signup rate.

goals.goal: Do mobile visitors sign up less than desktop visitors?
paraphrases: Is the signup rate lower on phones?
mobile vs desktop signups
Are desktop users more likely to register?
do people on mobile sign up less often

labels.why: Signup rate by device, across the whole period.

goals.goal: Do visitors from search sign up more than visitors from social?
paraphrases: Which converts better, search traffic or social traffic?
search vs social signup rate
Are social visitors less likely to sign up than search visitors?
does seach traffic register more then social

labels.why: Signup rate by channel, the two channels named.

goals.goal: After the redesign, did mobile signups improve more than desktop signups?
paraphrases: Did the new page help phones more than computers?
Did the change close the gap between mobile and desktop signups?
mobile lift vs desktop lift after the redesign
did the redesign help mobile users more

labels.why: How the mobile-desktop gap in signups moved after the date.

goals.goal: Is the new page more engaging?
paraphrases: Are people more engaged since the change?
Did engagement go up after the redesign?
is the new page stickier
do visitors interact more with the new version

labels.why: Pages viewed is the engagement measure.
Signing up is engagement of a kind.

goals.goal: Are we getting more signups per day since the change?
paraphrases: Has the daily number of signups gone up since the new page?
daily signups before vs after
Do we get more registrations each day now?
more signups a day after the change?

labels.why: Signups before and after. Whether to count totals or rates is a choice on the form, not a different question.

goals.goal: Did visitors who saw the new page sign up more than visitors who saw the old page on the same days?
paraphrases: Compare people shown the new page with people shown the old one at the same time.
Was there a holdout that kept the old signup page?
new page vs old page, same week, who signed up more
did the A/B test of the signup page win

goals.goal: Did people who saw the new page sign up more than people who didn't?
paraphrases: Compare visitors exposed to the new page with visitors who weren't.
exposed vs not exposed signup rate
Did the people who got the new page convert better than the rest?
do those who saw the redesign sign up more than those who didnt

goals.goal: Did the new signup page increase revenue?
paraphrases: Are we making more money since the signup page changed?
Did the redesign grow sales?
revenue impact of the new page
did the new page bring in more mony
